meta.title: Codex WS
meta.description: GPT models over the Codex-style Responses WebSocket transport (Codex CLI's supports_websockets): no extra model channel — the openai provider is intercepted in place, with the endpoint and key inherited from the DSH OpenAI provider by default. Explicit plugin overrides require both an endpoint and credentials; local Codex CLI config is not read. The composer WS/SSE button appears only while the current model is an OpenAI one.
